src/main/java/net/legendofwar/autarky/Au.summary: `Autarky` is the main `JavaPlugin` class that initializes the plugin, registers event listeners, and sets up command executors for administrative world management and utility tasks.

README.md.summary: `Autarky` is a Spigot plugin that optimizes server performance by disabling natural entity spawning, liquid flow, and block generation. It serves as a lightweight utility for testing features.

src/main/java/net/legendofwar/autarky/Em.summary: `EmptyWorldChunkGenerator` extends `ChunkGenerator` to provide a void world environment. It serves as the project's custom generator for creating empty, featureless chunks.

src/main/java/net/legendofwar/autarky/co.summary: `AutarkyFixChunksCommand` implements `CommandExecutor` to provide an administrative command for scanning and repairing specific block types within defined world boundaries in the Autarky project.

`MultiverseCommand` manages custom world loading and configuration. It implements `CommandExecutor` and `TabCompleter` to handle world-related commands and initializes worlds defined in the plugin configuration on startup.
`AutarkyReloadCommand` implements `CommandExecutor` to handle the plugin's reload command. It triggers `autarky.createConfig()` to refresh configuration settings during runtime.
`StructureToRPCommand` implements `CommandExecutor` to export Minecraft structures into JSON format. It serves as a utility for developers to convert in-game builds into resource pack data.

src/main/resources/plugin.yml.summary: This file defines the `Autarky` plugin metadata, entry point, and command registrations. It serves as the primary configuration manifest for the Bukkit/Spigot plugin environment.
